headline: Missouri S&T win all four, conceding once
dek: Missouri S&T have won all four matches they have played, and the only goal they have conceded came on the opening night at Northeastern State. Seven different players have shared their ten goals, and conference play has opened with clean sheets against Upper Iowa and at William Jewell.
displaced_by: Missouri S&T four wins from four with one goal conceded after the 9 September results night

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist's seventeen goals still exceed the six lowest-scoring programmes' total together, but the shape is no longer one side and a field: Drury, Missouri S&T and Quincy have closed on them while Southwest Baptist have not played since they were held.

wire.line: Missouri-St. Louis are the first side to score against Southwest Baptist this season, and they did it twice.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches past their date carry no published result: Drury's at home to Evangel and away at Wash U, Missouri S&T's visit to Kentucky Wesleyan, and Lincoln's home match with McKendree, the one conference match of 9 September without a result.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Drury have won four and lost one, scoring twelve and conceding four; the defeat was at home to Oklahoma Christian, and at least eight different players have scored for them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: William Jewell have lost all four of their matches and have yet to score; they have conceded seven, the last two of them at home to Missouri S&T.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Asgrimur Vidisson has made twenty-two saves for Maryville and conceded five goals, with two clean sheets; Maryville have won three and lost two.

last_match.line: Drury have not lost since Oklahoma Christian visited; Illinois Springfield are still without a win.

next_match.line: Southwest Baptist are unbeaten and have scored in every match they have played; the trip to Avila is outside the conference.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
